QUICK START

Road Trip · No TV · No Wi-Fi

  1. Ask a grown-up to get Pandemoni.Free on the App Store, for iPhone and iPad.
  2. Turn on a phone's Personal Hotspot.Everyone in the car joins it. No internet needed.
  3. The host taps Play A Game.Then Play without a TV.
  4. Everyone scans the host's code.They play in the browser. The driver sits this one out.

Two games are free for 4 or more players, so the whole car can play. Fewer of you? More games, from 3 players, are in the app.
